recommendation: seqs16 meets 'burst ttft_p95 <= 3000 ms' in every repeat with the highest median goodput (100% of SLO-selected requests). Advisory: verify on the production model and workload.
notes: the 95% interval is a bootstrap over requests pooled across repeats (within-run; requests share engine steps and are not independent), so it understates run-to-run uncertainty; the [min..max] over repeats is the run-to-run range

throughput (tok/s) is measured over each run's window; with an open-loop (arrival-paced) workload it reflects the arrival schedule unless the system saturates, so compare latency and energy per token, and use a saturating workload to compare capacity
